exceptions.justification: The pinned OSM relation snapshot contains waterbody/river relations whose complete topology is not a deterministic contract segment match: reservoir relations are polygon/waterbody networks, Ialomita contains an out-of-country relation tail, Olt has multiple competing relations, and Timis has several overlapping fragmented relations. No contract ownership, source row, or sector mapping is changed; findings remain visible for remediation.

Siret is a county-border course. The reviewed buffered county intervals intentionally overlap at border transitions; the UI resolver selects the smallest explicit interval. The two OSM relations do not provide deterministic ownership of a single contract segment, so the audit finding remains visible rather than changing contractual ranges.
